Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 66
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely concluded that “Casino Royale” was the highest‑rated eligible film and available on Netflix (US) despite conflicting evidence. It relied on an outdated, user‑curated IMDb list (missing newer titles like Knives Out) and accepted NetflixReleases’ claim of Netflix US availability while ignoring JustWatch results indicating the film wasn’t on Netflix US. It failed to reconcile conflicting sources or verify directly on Netflix US, leading to an incorrect final answer.
